text:
rachel: Quick thread: console wants a per-route 'policy impact' column. It needs richer route metadata from SDKs. Proposal: opt-in route-meta v2 header with sampling.

joel: From SDK POV add opt-in flag default=false. Emit both short v1 header and v2 when enabled so proxies don't break.

maria: Telemetry: tag events with meta_source=v2|v1|reconstructed and metric decode_errors. Also track sampled counts.

tess: Python should expose per-request hook for dynamic meta; TS/Go can have setter API. Sampling hint header would be useful: X-Route-Meta-Sample.

joel: Example TS snippet: `new Redwood({key, routeMetaOptIn: true, routeMetaSampler: 0.01}); client.setRouteMeta(()=>({priority:'gold',quota:'alpha'}))`.

rachel: Console UX: show "beta route meta" banner in staging and a sampled badge on rows. Fall back to v1 gracefully.

joel: Tests: roundtrip encode/decode, fallback when v2 missing, header size regression. Will add unit + smoke tests.

deploy-bot: deploy: console canary staging-console-9 started 1 nodes. link: https://deploys.redwood/staging/console/9

maria: Action items: joel SDK PRs, tess add server decode + metrics, rachel docs + comms. Follow-up sync tomorrow 9am.
